E1.permitted_wording: The full frozen scene domain contains at least one pair of graph-inequivalent interpretations with the same rendered observation; therefore no deterministic decoder is exact on every scene in that domain.
proof_obligations: the witness tuple is a member of the unchanged parent tuple domain
both interpretation indices are members of the complete parent interpretation set I(q)
scene rendering is definitionally independent of interpretation index
the two canonical graphs are not equivalent
the instantiated Lean theorem has no axioms

E2.permitted_wording: The full frozen tuple domain contains the preregistered cross-tuple pairs whose complete canonical Gray8 observations are byte-for-byte equal while the selected graphs are not equivalent; therefore the frozen observation map is not injective up to graph equivalence.
proof_obligations: all sixteen tuples are members of the unchanged parent tuple domain
both independent verifiers reconstruct tuples and interpretations from the parent contract
both independent verifiers rerender raw and padded canvases without importing producer implementations
canonical raster equality is complete byte equality and not digest equality
the selected canonical graphs are not equivalent
all eight preregistered pairs pass or E2 is NO_GO

Q.k_overflow_policy: If K exceeds maximum_quotient_cardinality, reject Q before representative rendering; do not merge cells, sample K, narrow axes, or revise the bound in v0.6.
Q.permitted_wording: Only after every Q obligation and every resource gate passes: the complete unchanged parent domain has the reported Raster, Evidence, and Graph closure through the proved quotient K.
proof_obligations: a finite K and a surjection pi from every parent tuple to K are defined
pi cells are nonempty, pairwise disjoint, and their union is the entire parent domain
the proved K cardinality equals the enumerated K cardinality and does not exceed the frozen maximum
the canonical renderer factors through pi on every parent tuple
each quotient cell has a complete interpretation and graph-union summary
every element of K is enumerated exactly once
all Lean coverage and factorization theorems have no axioms
two independent verifiers agree on full-byte class identity and all closure roots

S.permitted_wording: For the preregistered predicates, the unchanged parent population has the reported stratified finite-population confidence bounds at the frozen simultaneous confidence level; this is not a full closure or a proof of a global collision rate.

sample_plan.familywise_method: Bonferroni over every preregistered predicate and every stratum using finite-population bounds
sample_plan.seed_derivation: SHA256 framed with the parent contract hash, v0.6 contract hash, and two 32-byte custodian shares committed before source freeze and revealed only after the sample implementation is frozen

statistical_boundaries: all selected tuple IDs and all failures remain in the denominator
deterministic axis-extrema sentinels are reported separately and excluded from estimates
zero observed failures is reported only as an upper confidence bound and never as a full-domain zero
sample duplicate counts describe only the sample and are not estimators of full ambiguity prevalence
a pair-collision rate is allowed only for a separately preregistered pair population and pair map
no optional stopping, replacement, predicate revision, stratum revision, or sample-size revision is permitted

contract_format: closed canonical JSON instance; the validating schema is frozen before any v0.6 witness, sample, quotient, verifier, or result implementation

domain_binding.interpretation_scope: all interpretations in the parent dependent set I(q), with no active or post-hoc validity predicate
domain_binding.scene_domain: dependent pairs (q,i) for every q in the complete parent tuple domain and every i in I(q)

failure_policy.lane_failure_result: NO_GO for that lane without weakening its claim, reducing its domain, changing its sample, merging quotient cells, or raising its resource gate
failure_policy.post_hoc_change_policy: Any contract, schema, wording, resource, witness-plan, sample-plan, quotient-bound, or domain-binding change requires a new protocol version.
failure_policy.training_authorization_policy: No E1, E2, S, or Q result in v0.6 authorizes training.

independence.digest_role: digests are commitments and indexes only; equality claims use complete canonical bytes
independence.e1_logic_checker: Lean kernel with every exported theorem checked by #print axioms and an empty axiom set
independence.verifier_language_requirement: For E2 and Q, at least one verifier uses a different implementation language or runtime from the producer.
independence.verifier_recomputation: Each verifier reconstructs domain membership, interpretation membership, canonical graphs, raster preprocessing when applicable, and the claimed relation from the frozen parent contract and source freeze.

resource_accounting.artifact_definition: all authoritative lane outputs including witnesses, full-byte sidecars, manifests, logs, and validation records
resource_accounting.failure_rule: exceeding any frozen maximum, any OOM event, nonzero exit, missing selected record, verifier disagreement, or unsafe artifact tree makes that lane NO_GO
resource_accounting.rss_definition: peak aggregate resident bytes for the complete cgroup or process tree
resource_accounting.temporary_definition: maximum allocated bytes in a dedicated initially empty work filesystem
resource_accounting.wall_definition: CLOCK_MONOTONIC elapsed time from first process start through final fsync and immutable publication
resource_accounting.worker_definition: the exact fixed worker count in the selected lane resource gate; GPU execution is forbidden
